BLOXYS - Vote Tower Defense Simulator for BEST Game Trailer!|Default skin on the game trailer. }} ==Skin Trivia== * The '''War Machine''' has a unique upgrade animation at Level 5. When upgraded to that level, black smoke and purple will appear behind it. *The '''War Machine''' currently shares its Level 3 upgrade icon with the [[Turret]]. *The '''War Machine''' used to share most of its icons with the [[Accelerator]] before the [[v1.9.0|Violent Night Update]]. **The [[Accelerator]] used the correct upgrade image for Level 3 that the '''War Machine''' is meant to have at that level. Because of a bug, it uses the [[Turret]]'s Level 3 upgrade icon instead. ===Roblox Catalog=== *The helmet used by the Level 5 '''War Machine''' is the {{RLinkC|4776495405|The Bug Stomper}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The minigun exoskeleton used by the '''War Machine''' was originally made to be a UGC item. The item was never released, though it would end up being used in Tower Defense Simulator for '''War Machine'''. ==Update History== ''This only refers to cosmetic changes to the [[War Machine]].
